notes.title: Join the Lost Host Community!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256025/b6c8642d7196dd172e0f0a19bc8023213d287a55.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]
We’re building *Lost Host*, a game about a little RC car on a big emotional journey – and we want to bring you along for the ride.
[h2]🧠 Join us, leave your thoughts, and help shape the game![/h2]
🔗 TikTok: [[url=https://tiktok.com/@losthostgame]@losthostgame[/url]] 
🔗 Instagram: [[url=https://instagram.com/gest.lt]@gest.lt[/url]] 
🔗 Discord: [[url=https://discord.gg/Cd3zzMQPuA]Join our server[/url]]
🔗 Facebook: [[url=https://www.facebook.com/gestLT3D]Follow us here[/url]]
🔗 Youtube: [[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Gestlt]Follow us here[/url]]

[h1]Thank you for supporting us – every comment, like, or follow helps! ❤️[/h1]
